Name: Restore Backup
Description: Restore the database from a backup.

Name: Manage Fee Configuration
Description: Create and modify class fee configuration.

Name: View billing status checks
Description: Check unposted or missing charges and billing cycle status. General report categories use Reports.View.

Name: View annual fee receipts
Description: Open and print annual student fee receipts; also needs report and fee viewing access.

Name: View student and finance reports
Description: Open student and finance report categories and their exports. Fees.Reports.View is a separate billing-status check.

Name: Maintain student records and lifecycle
Description: Edit saved student details and photos, manage family membership, re-admission, placement/status and legacy/lifecycle maintenance.

Name: Open family workspace
Description: View student families; changing members also requires Students.Administer.

Name: Leave Student
Description: Mark a student as leaving the school.

Name: Manage system administration
Description: Manage users, roles, permissions and audit access. The Administrator role separately retains full application authority.

Name: View roles and permissions
Description: Read role definitions and the permission catalog. Editing also requires System.Roles.Manage.

Name: Edit Accountant permissions
Description: Save the Accountant description and permissions; requires role viewing access. Administrator remains protected with full authority.

Name: View users
Description: Read user accounts. Editing also requires System.Users.Manage and role viewing access.

Name: Create and edit users
Description: Save normal user accounts and reset their passwords; requires user and role viewing access.
